page.layout: One text column, full page width, with a marginal note block in the left margin beside the lines at "tas" to "dicant". Running head at the top, page number "64" at the head. No block below the text. The catchword sits at the bottom right.

main_text.p: fringunt, ut tantæ liti dirimendæ haud idonei videantur; agmen ducit Polycar-pus in illâ quæ ejus nomine circumfertur Epistolâ, ex quâ primum pro Ignatianis petit testimonium Vindiciarum Autor, utque majoris fit ponderis pluribus pro-bat hanc Philippensibus inscriptam Epi-stolam, genuinum esse Polycarpi Ioannis Apostoli Discipuli fœtum: non diffiteba-tur Dallæus neque ego post illum diffiteor extitisse Polycarpi nomine ad Phillipen-ses Epistolam, quæ magnæ erat apud no-strorum vetustissimos famæ; quæritur tantùm num aliquid prohibeat, quomi-nus certa & indubitata sit testimonij fi-des; duo quædam nequaquam contem-nenda hoc prohibere dixerat præstantissi-mus Dallæus; priùs quidem, quod ejus epistolæ, ex quâ descriptum est testimo-nium non sit apud omnes recepta autori-Dall. cap. 32. pag.426.tas; sunt enim, inquit scriptores, & iì qui-dem gravissimi, qui eam apocryphàm esse ju-dicant, & in apocryphorum censu reponunt. Scriptores illi sunt Nicephorus Patriar-cha Constantinopolitanus, & Anastasius Ecclesiæ Romanæ Bibliothecarius, in In-diculo enim quem ille edidit, & quem iste adoptavit, Ignatij, Polycarpi, Pastoris & Hermæ libri vel scripta ad apocrypha amandantur: Ut telum istud declina-

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the printed top line. Catchword at bottom right reads as "rec" in bold type, last letter uncertain; probably "recte". The first line "fringunt" continues from the previous page. Italic spans are approximate where the type is partly worn. Printed spellings "Phillipen-ses", "diffiteor", "iì" and "Ioannis" kept as printed. Marginal note is one block of three short lines (Dall. / cap. 32. / pag.426.). Show-through and a dark ink spot near the bottom are omitted.
